topic: Filter issue for Provence Malls data
summary_markdown:
A discussion occurred regarding a filtering issue in the analytics platform concerning 'Provence' data. Specifically, filters do not function correctly when selecting 'Malls' within the 'Network Malls' option. The functionality works only when all screens are selected, but fails for individual malls.

[me] explained that fixing this requires significant logic overhaul and multiple days of work, including bug catching.
[p1] acknowledged the issue and mentioned an upcoming training session on Monday.
decisions: The filtering logic for Malls needs a major overhaul to function correctly.
action_items: [me] will implement the fix after the TGI demographics demo.
